## Overview

Template context of a `TemplateRef` tooltip (`let-arrow="arrow" let-placement="placement"`). Values are
signals so an `OnPush`/zoneless template stays in sync after flips and repositioning.

- **Kind:** Interface
- **Source:** [packages/primitives/src/tooltip/tooltip.types.ts:30](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/primitives/src/tooltip/tooltip.types.ts#L30)

| `readonly arrow` | `Signal<OverlayArrowGeometry \| null>` | Arrow geometry of the open tooltip; `null` until measured or when no arrow size is set. |
